components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A direct, celebratory call to action for fetching or progressing through the dad-joke experience.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { color: #09131f; background: linear-gradient(130deg, #d7f7a1, #67d98f 45%, #2bcf6c); border: 1px solid rgba(11, 143, 77, 0.56); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(13, 33, 57, 0.14); font: 600 0.9rem 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 0.78rem 1.75rem; transition: all 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.22, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(130deg, #e7ffb7, #8ce3ae 42%, #1ca95a); box-shadow: 0 24px 48px rgba(8, 16, 29, 0.24); transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01); }

components.name: Joke Card
components.description: The signature glassy vessel for an individual joke and its category signal.
components.css: .ds-joke-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84); border: 1px solid rgba(15, 58, 96, 0.18); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(13, 33, 57, 0.14); color: #102a43; padding: 2rem; position: relative; } .ds-joke-card::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2bcf6c, #d7f7a1, #35d07f); content: ''; height: 4px; inset: 0 0 auto; position: absolute; } .ds-category { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2bcf6c, #0d9f4f); border-radius: 999px; color: white; display: inline-block; font: 600 0.75rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.5px; padding: 8px 16px; }

narrative.overview: Dad-A-Base uses a luminous green-and-cyan signal palette, translucent surfaces, and practical type roles to support both joke discovery and technical demonstration. The default system is bright and celebratory without becoming a generic enterprise dashboard; the 90s theme remains a separate, intentionally maximal escape hatch.
keyCharacteristics: Luminous green-and-cyan signal color over light and deep-blue gradient fields.
Ambiently lifted translucent panels with soft blur and responsive motion.
Bold uppercase display headlines balanced by pragmatic grotesk and mono utility text.
Playful discovery cues that do not obscure real controls or product status.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Spreadsheet Rule
rules.body: Use green and cyan to orient people toward actions, focus, and delight; do not turn the default experience into a muted, dense enterprise dashboard.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Bebas Neue for the big public statement, Space Grotesk for reading and operating, and IBM Plex Mono only for compact signals and labels.

rules.name: The Float With Purpose Rule
rules.body: Use elevation to confirm interaction or isolate a meaningful surface; do not layer cards inside cards just to create visual activity.

dos: Do use Fresh Green for primary action and active state while reserving Sky Pulse for focus, subtle interactive fields, and ambient background energy.
Do preserve the default light/dark system as paired experiences with the same hierarchy and readable contrast.
Do keep the 90s theme visually self-contained as a deliberate celebratory alternate mode.
donts: Don't replace the green-and-cyan signal language with muted dashboard neutrals or data-grid-heavy composition on public discovery surfaces.
Don't use Bebas Neue for dense paragraph text or IBM Plex Mono for long-form reading.
Don't introduce motion that ignores the global prefers-reduced-motion safeguard.
Don't blend the 90s theme's hard-border, blinking, or pixel-art language into the default system.
